incidents.description: Dock workers at Port of Singapore have initiated a 72-hour strike over wage disputes, causing severe container handling delays.
Cyclone Biparjoy approaching western Indian coast. Port operations suspended. Vessels rerouted to alternate berths.
New regulatory inspection requirements for electronic components. Additional 48-hour customs clearance time expected.
Record container volumes causing 15+ vessel queue. Average wait time increased to 4 days. Chassis shortage reported.
Persistent heavy rainfall across Netherlands causing minor delays in port operations. Visibility reduced for crane operations.
Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Red Sea region. Multiple shipping lines suspending transits through Suez Canal.
Brent crude surged 15% in 48 hours. Bunker fuel costs at Singapore up 22%. Carriers adding emergency fuel surcharges.
Severe monsoon flooding in Mumbai metropolitan area. Road connectivity to JNPT disrupted. Container evacuation delayed.
Two STS gantry cranes at Yangshan Deep Water Port offline for emergency maintenance. Terminal throughput reduced by 30%.
Surge in Asian imports causing berth allocation delays. Feeder vessel connections disrupted at ECT Delta terminal.
Typhoon Gaemi approaching East China Sea. Shanghai port authority issued Level III emergency response. Vessel departures halted.
Truck driver shortage in Southern California affecting container drayage. Average pickup wait time increased to 6 hours.
New OFAC sanctions list update affecting 12 vessels. Enhanced screening procedures causing clearance delays at Jebel Ali.
Customs officers at JNPT staging work slowdown over staffing concerns. Document processing times tripled.
Ransomware attack on port management system at APM Terminals. Container tracking and gate operations disrupted.
